text: dshtools-sensevoice-input 是为 DSH Desktop 提供本地语音输入的插件。在输入框工具栏加入麦克风按钮，并在输入区域显示识别状态；用户点击录音、再次点击结束后，插件把音频转换为 WAV 并交给本机 SenseVoiceSmall 进程识别，再将文字写入当前输入草稿，同时展示语言和情感标签。它还显示模型就绪、处理中、完成或错误状态，适合希望通过说话向 DSH Desktop 输入内容的用户。使用前需要准备装有 funasr 和 SenseVoiceSmall 的 Python 推理环境，可通过环境变量指定 Python 路径。

dshtools-sensevoice-input adds local voice input to DSH Desktop. Record up to 60 seconds with the composer microphone; local SenseVoiceSmall transcribes the audio and inserts text with language and emotion tags. Python with funasr and SenseVoiceSmall is required.
想在 DSH Desktop 里直接对着麦克风说话并把内容填进输入框。

让 DSH Desktop 用本机的 SenseVoiceSmall 把录音转成文字。
我想知道语音识别是在处理中还是已经完成了。
录音结束后能不能显示识别出的语言和情感标签？
麦克风录音如何转换成识别服务能处理的音频？
How can I dictate text directly into the DSH Desktop composer?
I need local speech recognition that fills the current draft and shows its status.
dshtools-sensevoice-input 的功能「麦克风语音输入」：点击输入框旁的麦克风开始录音，再次点击结束，最长录音时间为 60 秒；识别完成后将文字追加到当前草稿。
dshtools-sensevoice-input 的功能「本机语音识别」：录音音频被解码并编码为 WAV，再提交给本机 SenseVoiceSmall 推理进程，返回识别文本及语言、情感信息。
dshtools-sensevoice-input 的功能「识别状态提示」：输入区域显示处理中、完成或错误信息，完成时可显示识别标签和文本摘要；麦克风按钮也查询模型就绪状态。
dshtools-sensevoice-input 的功能「推理进程状态与重启」：宿主端提供状态查询和重启路由，可报告模型是否就绪，并在重启时终止当前推理进程。

基于 [SenseVoiceSmall](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/iic/SenseVoiceSmall) 的 **DSH Desktop 本地语音输入插件**:点击输入框旁的 🎤 说话,文本自动写入输入框草稿,并显示语言/情感标签(如 `zh · NEUTRAL`)。支持 50+ 语言,全程本地 CPU 推理,音频不出本机。

dshtools-sensevoice-input README · 特性：- 🎤 composer 内嵌麦克风按钮,识别文本自动写入草稿(`inputActions.setDraft`)
- 🏷️ 语言/情感标签解析(`<|zh|><|NEUTRAL|>…` → 结构化字段)
- 🖥️ funasr + SenseVoiceSmall 本地推理,无任何云服务
- ⚡ 模型懒加载(首次 10–30s,之后单次几秒);Python 进程崩溃自愈
- 🌓 主题自适应 UI

dshtools-sensevoice-input README · 安装 / 卸载：**1. 准备推理环境(一次性,约 5 GB)**

```powershell
.\scripts\setup.ps1   # uv → Python 3.12 venv → torch/funasr → 下载 SenseVoiceSmall 模型
```

> 默认安装到 `~\.dsh-sensevoice`,模型缓存 `~\.cache\modelscope`;
> 也可自行用任意装有 funasr 的 Python,并通过环境变量 `DSHSENSEVOICE_PYTHON` 指定解释器。

**2. 安装插件(任选其一,重启 DSH Desktop 后生效)**

```powershell

dshtools-sensevoice-input README · dshtools-sensevoice-input：A local voice-input plugin for **DSH Desktop** powered by [SenseVoiceSmall](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/iic/SenseVoiceSmall): click the 🎤 beside the composer, speak, and the transcript is written into the input draft with language/emotion tags (e.g. `zh · NEUTRAL`). Supports 50+ languages; inference runs fully on your CPU and audio never leaves the machine.

dshtools-sensevoice-input README · Features：- 🎤 Inline mic button in the composer; transcripts land in the draft (`inputActions.setDraft`)
- 🏷️ Language/emotion tag parsing (`<|zh|><|NEUTRAL|>…` → structured fields)
- 🖥️ funasr + SenseVoiceSmall inference, no cloud services
- ⚡ Lazy model loading (~10–30s first time, seconds afterwards); self-healing Python worker
- 🌓 Theme-aware UI

dshtools-sensevoice-input README · Install / uninstall：**1. Prepare the inference environment (one-time, ~5 GB)**

```powershell
.\scripts\setup.ps1   # uv → Python 3.12 venv → torch/funasr → SenseVoiceSmall model
```

> Defaults to `~\.dsh-sensevoice` with the model cached under `~\.cache\modelscope`.
> Any funasr-equipped Python works too — point at it with the `DSHSENSEVOICE_PYTHON` env var.

**2. Install the plugin (pick one; restart DSH Desktop afterwards)**

```powershell

dshtools-sensevoice-input README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Remedy |
| --- | --- |
| `HTTP 405` / `403` after clicking | Pre-1.0.1 timing issue; update to the latest version and restart |
| 「无法访问麦克风」 | Allow the microphone permission in Electron |
| `python_not_found` | Run `scripts\setup.ps1` first |
| `model_load_failed` | Model cache missing — re-run the model download step |
| First recognition is slow | Expected: the CPU loads the model in 10–30s, then reuses it |
